plugins.name: github-reports
plugins.description: Read-only GitHub digests: repo activity and project ticket movement, each usable on its own.

plugins.name: platform-ops
plugins.description: JoyStream platform alert diagnosis for the ops agent: read-only Railway evidence, one reply in the alert's Slack thread.

plugins.name: release-announcements
plugins.description: Customer-friendly GitHub release roundups for a date range, posted as one colored Slack message.

plugins.name: website-audits
plugins.description: Website audits that judge pages and search results the agent already fetched, such as AI answer-engine (AEO/GEO) readiness.

plugins.name: content-studio
plugins.description: Social content from real work: decide whether recent GitHub activity is worth a post, then draft LinkedIn and X posts in the author's voice. Drafts only; nothing is posted.

plugins.name: gtm-research
plugins.description: Go-to-market research judgments over evidence the agent already fetched: ICP qualification, pre-call briefs, company profiles, trigger events and public profiles of people, each cited or marked unknown.

plugins.name: gtm-outreach
plugins.description: Outreach and follow-up drafts for founders and sellers: a first-touch email or LinkedIn DM from a brief, and a sales-call debrief with a follow-up email. Drafts only; nothing is sent.

plugins.name: batch-processing
plugins.description: Generic fan-out helpers for list agents: prepare a list into bound slots, then rank the per-item results into one list.

plugins.name: channel-delivery
plugins.description: Render any skill's channel-neutral report as Slack, Teams, Discord, email-draft or markdown content, inside each channel's limits; the agent's delivery step posts it.

plugins.name: skill-doctor
plugins.description: Help authors make their own skills conformant: draft the judgment fixes (a vague description, a body that fetches, a missing output schema) as a diff to review. Drafts only; nothing is edited or pushed.
